mathematics.value_basis: Volume: int64 shares, 0 <= v <= 2^63-1 (negative is BOUNDS). Price fields: positive int64 coefficients at ConfigSpec.price_unit.scale (0..18), one currency and one adjustment basis; the statistic is computed on the integer coefficients and divided by 10^scale only at publication, so no float ever enters a comparison or a sort. Cumulative pace operands and window sums are exact wide integers (at most 4096 terms of at most 2^63-1); only published values are float64, so no OVERFLOW path exists for them.
mathematics.sample: multiset X of n exact rationals, sorted x(1) <= ... <= x(n)
mathematics.median: x((n+1)/2) for odd n; (x(n/2) + x(n/2+1))/2 for even n
mathematics.mad: MAD(X) = median(|x_i - median(X)|), raw (scale constant 1), exact; zero is an available value
mathematics.mad_scale: the normal-consistent constant is NOT applied by any header; z-like normalization takes a caller rational k = scale_num/scale_den (no default)
mathematics.quantile: type 7: h = (n-1)*p exactly, j = floor(h), g = h - j, Q = x(j+1) + g*(x(j+2) - x(j+1)); p = 1 returns x(n); n = 1 returns x(1)
mathematics.history_rank: PR = (L + E/2)/n with L = #{s < x}, E = #{s == x} over the prior sample (target not in the sample), x the target value; PR in [0,1] and 0 and 1 are reachable
mathematics.cohort_rank: PR = (L + E/2)/n over all eligible members including the target member; rank = 1 + #{v > x}; PR is never 0 or 1
mathematics.pace_operand: y_j = V[j,b] (bucket profile) or sum_{c=0..b} V[j,c] (cumulative profile) for session j; y for the target the same way
mathematics.pace_baseline: M = median(retained y_j), D = MAD(retained y_j) over prior sessions only
mathematics.pace_ratio: y / M, null with zero_denominator when M = 0 (for nonnegative samples M = 0 implies D = 0)
mathematics.pace_z: (y - M)/(k*D), null with zero_denominator when D = 0 (also when y = M); negative values are not clamped
mathematics.mean_ratio: ((sum over S sessions)/S) / ((sum over L sessions)/L) = L*sumS/(S*sumL); windows end at t-1 (prior_only) or t (current_inclusive); zero baseline -> zero_denominator
mathematics.publication: exact rational then one correctly rounded (half-even) float64; int64 cohort.rank exact

acceptance_rules.exact_float64: reference is a dyadic rational with numerator < 2^53: every exact-rational or Decimal120 path produces it without rounding, so the published float64 must equal the hex bit for bit
acceptance_rules.exact_plus_zero: reference exactly 0 from exact integer arithmetic (equal integers subtract to zero): bit-exact +0.0, never -0.0
acceptance_rules.tolerance: abs(y - r) <= max(8*ulp(r), 1e-12*abs(r)) with r the fixture float64 (the R17 numeric error contract)

fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. K = 100 knowledge cutoff, default known_at 50. History slots list the governed sessions 0..t-1 in order, then the target: an integer is a priced row (field value, volume or price coefficient); ('x', v) a session with a declared exclusion fact (its own value is ignored); ('xu',) and ('xf',) an exclusion fact with known_at null or 150; ('f', v) a row with known_at 150 > K; ('u', v) known_at null; ('p', v, ka) explicit known_at; 'null' a row present with a null field (volume column null, or the price column null); 'gap' no row and a declared incomplete IntervalCoverage for that session; 'absent' no row and no coverage. Cohort members map instrument -> the same notation; 'absent' is a declared member with no DAILY row. Pace prior_sessions list sessions 0..t-1 with close = actual close offset (default 300 = full session), cells = per-bucket volumes for the 3 buckets of the grid (the same cell notation; None is null volume) and ex = declared exclusion; target_session has C = market cutoff offset, close = actual close offset, cells (None = no current rows). Offsets are relative to the actual session open; session opens are j*1000 nominal in canonical expansion. Construction rules: prices positive; volume 0 rows carry null OHLC when any price column is delivered (shared BAR/DAILY rule); a row with positive volume and a null supplied price is malformed (INVALID_SCHEMA), so null_field is reached only through a null volume column or a null price column on a series whose field is that price; no recursion, epoch or anchor exists in these producers (the pace profile resets at every session open, carry across sessions is not supported); float results carry the exact rational, float64, float.hex and the per-output acceptance rule; rank outputs are listed per fixture; a fixture evaluates every listed output unless it lists only some.

decisions_proposed.decision: robust.mad and pace.baseline_mad are RAW MAD (scale constant 1). No normal-consistent constant is applied. The z-like pace.robust_z divides by k*MAD with k = scale_num/scale_den supplied by the caller (no default; k = 1 is the raw form; a caller wanting the normal-consistent form supplies its own rational).
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: fixed constant 1.4826 baked in; both raw and scaled published; k as float
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Even n returns the arithmetic mean of the two middle values, exact (half-integers are representable).
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Hyndman-Fan type 7 (linear interpolation of order statistics) with exact rational p; policy label ef3-robust1 freezes it.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: type 1 inverse empirical CDF / nearest rank, type 6, type 8, type 9 (each a new policy label)
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Percentile rank is mid-rank (L + E/2)/n: ties count half (same convention as the accepted EF2 band-width percentile). History rank excludes the target from the sample (so 0 and 1 are reachable); cohort rank includes the target member (so 0 and 1 are not reachable).
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Competition rank, 1 is the largest, ties share the best rank (1,1,3).
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Exact integer/rational arithmetic, one correctly rounded float64 at publication; per-fixture acceptance rule (exact_float64, exact_plus_zero, tolerance). Windows, samples and cumulative sums are never floats.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: Decimal120 (R17) intermediates with the R17 tolerance, which this rule is compatible with
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The window is the N governed sessions immediately before the target (prior-only), counted on the supplied governed grid, never compressed. The target value never enters the sample. N and min_history m are caller parameters with no default.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: N most recent eligible sessions (extend back past exclusions)
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: A declared exclusion fact removes the session from the sample and from the expected count; it is not an observation and not a gap. min_history bounds the retained sample size. Gap, absent, null, unknown and future slots in the window are never tolerated.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: count exclusions as gaps (EQ031 style, blocking); extend the window backwards
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: A governed slot with no row and no coverage is absent_input (missing_input); declared incomplete coverage is governed_gap; null field is null_field; known_at null is unknown_availability; known_at > K is future_knowledge. This follows the merged EF2 contracts and differs from EQ031/EQ032, which report an existing missing prior slot as incomplete_coverage.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: robust.median, robust.mad and robust.quantile take their unit from the configured operand field (shares for volume, currency/share for price fields); the ledger records both.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: separate header ids per operand family
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Cohort rank is withheld (null, incomplete_coverage, partial_universe) unless every declared member is eligible; the target member's own readiness reports its ordinary missing_input reason; declared size below min_population is insufficient_history (EF2 precedent).
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: publish a partial rank with partial counts (breadth precedent)
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The target instrument must be a declared member; all values share the target session, unit and basis; the declared population is the I/O layer's supplied fact.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: pace profile is cumulative (sum of buckets 0..b from the session open) or bucket (bucket b alone); config choice, no default.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: b = the last bucket whose end is <= min(market cutoff, actual target close) relative to the actual open; none elapsed is future_market, none fitting the session is ineligible.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: caller-declared bucket index in config
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: A prior session whose actual close precedes the end of bucket b is structurally ineligible: removed from the sample and from expected (not volume 0, not a gap). A row delivered for an ineligible bucket, or a row not matching a grid offset, is a refusal.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Compatible current observations are the target session's bucket rows 0..b (same instrument, session, exact grid bounds, unit, basis); a consolidated per-bucket volume is supplied, multi-venue merging is not done here.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: ratio = y/M; z = (y - M)/(k*D); both are plain arithmetic relations with caller parameters; zero M or zero D is not_applicable/zero_denominator even when y equals M.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The bucket grid travels as the grid REFERENCE role; config carries grid_version only.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: offsets in config chunks (R17 context style)
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: ef3.volume_ratio_mean is its own producer, identity, label and fixture set; the median/MAD outputs are never replaced by it.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: a mean profile inside ef3.volume_pace_robust (rejected by the wave decision)
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: numerator_inclusion and baseline_inclusion are independent caller parameters (prior_only or current_inclusive); windows may overlap and S may exceed L. Current-inclusive windows consume the target row; prior-only windows do not and stay available without it.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Complete governed windows only: no exclusions, no gaps, no shrunken denominators; zero baseline is not_applicable/zero_denominator, and no negative baseline exists because volume >= 0.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternative: reuse the robust exclusion admission
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: One common ratio operand for all consumers; consumers differ by config (S, L, inclusions), not by per-key code.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: absent_input, unknown_availability, future_knowledge, null_field, ineligible, governed_gap, future_market, partial_universe, insufficient_history, no_eligible_observations, empty_universe, zero_denominator (the money-flow precedence extended by two incomplete-coverage reasons).
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Witness order and row ids as in the quality section.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: quantile and scale are reduced int64 pairs; floats, bools and decimal text are INVALID_CONFIG.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Batch and full replay only; update, restore and merge are UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY.
decisions_proposed.state: coordinator-decided (accepted as proposed), pending owner review

layer_responsibilities.library: admission of supplied facts, window and population selection, exact statistics, ratios, quality, evidence and every library refusal; pure and deterministic; shared sample/summary kernel reused by #489, #490 and the admission by #666 without coupling output readiness
layer_responsibilities.io_611: maps ordered daily and bucket rows, session bounds, exclusion facts, declared populations and the grid facts exactly as supplied with original known_at; never sorts, fills, imputes, converts scale, picks windows or computes a statistic; maps results unchanged
layer_responsibilities.worker_612: routes selected outputs and bounded shared histories, executes one config per complete result, binds inputs and config digest, persists the library result unchanged; direct, adapter, worker and stored results identical including refusal class

non_goals: no thresholds, scanners, alert or catalogue policy (#518)
no default window, minimum history, quantile, scale, ratio or inclusion
no replacement of median/MAD by mean ratios and no mean computed inside the robust producers
no approximate algorithm (no streaming sketch, t-digest or sampled quantile)
no calendar lookup, session discovery or exclusion discovery
no acquisition, adjustment, currency conversion or imputation
no rank of a forming daily value (use pace)
no new DataKind, DTO, codec, scheduler, validator change or error code
no performance, parity, release or publication claim
no private-source equivalence or source formula
coordinator_freeze: Frozen as ef3-robust1, ef3-pace1 and ef3-mean1 (v1) for implementation once this PR merges (coordinator statement; no review or acceptance claim by the author). Any change to a convention, label semantics, header, role or fixture after merge requires a new policy label and an amendment document. Reset epoch mode only (pace resets at each session open; no carry). No defaults for windows, k, p, m.
hosting: packages/features EF3 module, config namespace ef3.*, separate catalog; describe_intraday() and its digest unchanged; no package version bump
population_kind_rule: ef3.population.member is the shared declared-population kind for EF3 (reused by contract F). Self-contained definition: one row per declared member; instrument_id = member, session_id = target session, reference_id x1:B(population_id) identical across members, effective bounds = target session bounds, text = snapshot id, price/factor null, known_at nullable. Duplicate identity (instrument, session, reference_id) is rejected with DUPLICATE (RF12); the target instrument must be a member.
header_ledger_to_be_applied: the 13 headers above are to be applied by a sibling amendment document after the freeze; unit members (cohort.rank) is already present in the declared-breadth catalog but is new to this ledger
amendment_note: Additive producer-set and header-ledger entries needed in the shared contract are recorded here as to-be-applied: three producers, thirteen headers (units shares, fraction, currency/share and members already exist), role schemas and four new reference fact kinds. A sibling amendment document follows the freeze. No change to shared validators is required or proposed.
